guide_probe.scope: One independent saved guide/control, edited and restored in memory; no disk save or render.

cross_section_proxy.scope: Centerline covariance at matching saved control indices, projected onto raw guide central-difference tangent planes. These are geometric proxies, not physical bundle volume, optical coverage or visual acceptance. Whole-group 3D PCA also contains centerline bending and longitudinal extent.
cross_section_proxy.units: Standard deviations use saved identity object/scene coordinates; ratios are dimensionless. No millimeter calibration.
cross_section_proxy.guide_frame_source: Actual saved native guide controls; no inferred frame from rendered pixels
